references.text: The Lord raised up a savior for Israel, which is the same pattern described in Judges 10:1 with Tola being raised up to save Israel.
Shamgar was raised up as judge after Ehud, just as Tola was raised up after Abimelech.
Abimelech mentioned in Judges 10:1 was Gideon's son who seized power in Shechem, and Tola was raised up after his death.
The minor judges Ibzan, Elon, and Abdon are described in a similar way to Tola, with brief mentions of their service.
Tola is mentioned as the son of Issachar in the genealogy, and Pua (Puva) is also mentioned as a son of Issachar.
Tola and Pua (Puva) are mentioned as sons of Issachar when Jacob went down to Egypt.
The hill country of Ephraim is mentioned as the place where Joshua was buried, the same mountain region where Tola lived in Shamir.
